context: Two friends discuss a play they saw
purpose: Teach: 悲鳴/若き/のぞい/いただか/むろん/彦/晃/泰

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨夜の舞台、最後、悲鳴で幕が下りた。
lines.en: Last night's performance ended with a scream cutting through the final moment.
lines.style: Bright, engaged opening. Lean forward slightly on 'scream'—vivid and theatrical. Pace quickens through the line, building energy. Voice has warmth underneath the animation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 若き役者たち、勢いあったよね。
lines.en: Those young actors had real momentum.
lines.style: Gentle observation, not loud. Soft admiration in the tone. Steady, even pace. A small smile in the voice—noticing something good without needing to announce it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 袖からのぞいてたスタッフ、緊張感が伝わってきた。
lines.en: I could feel the tension radiating from the staff watching from the wings.
lines.style: Thoughtful, looking inward slightly. Soft pace, allowing space between phrases. Sensory detail in the voice—remembering what she felt, not just saw. Trailing breath at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: パンフレットいただかなかったの?私も後で読みたい。
lines.en: You didn't grab a pamphlet? I'd love to read it later too.
lines.style: Light curiosity, genuinely interested. Quick, conversational pace. Slight rise at the end of 'later'—opening a small invitation. Warm and easy, no pressure.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: むろん貰ったわよ、後で渡すね。
lines.en: Of course I did—I'll give it to you.
lines.style: Assured and generous. Soft laugh underneath, like she expected that question. Steady, unhurried delivery. Genuine warmth in offering, not performative.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 主演の彦先輩、有名な舞台俳優だよね。
lines.en: Lead actor Hiko-senpai is a famous stage actor, isn't he.
lines.style: Bright recognition, a little lit up. Conversational lilt on the tail. Quick pace, light and easy. No reverence—just acknowledging something she already knows and finds interesting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 演出の晃さんも、新進気鋭。
lines.en: Director Akira-san is really talented too—you can tell he's going places.
lines.style: Animated approval, genuine excitement. Emphasis on 'talented'—conviction underneath. Forward energy through the line. Voice carries belief in what she's saying.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 制作の泰プロデューサー、頼もしいよね。
lines.en: Producer Yasushi really does hold things together.
lines.style: Warm closing sentiment. Steady, grounded tone. Slight emphasis on 'holds together'—acknowledging real work. Gentle fade at the end, like a satisfied exhale. The sound of genuine respect.
